title: Relationship Reaction Message Pack
description: 100 reactions × 30 variants. Every message contains one approved nickname, with emotion-matched natural wording. Receiver sees the exact same message.

rules.style: Natural Hinglish, English, Urdu-English, romantic, cute, flirty, playful, supportive, and serious depending on reaction.
rules.nicknames: Uses the user's approved relationship nickname list.
rules.emoji: Optional and emotion-matched; not forced on every message.
rules.nicknameRequirement: Exactly one approved nickname per message; within each reaction's 30 variants, all 30 nicknames are used exactly once.
rules.emotionalWriting: Reaction is expressed through the actual relationship message, not by saying the reaction name.
rules.genderNeutral: No gender-specific pronouns, roles, or descriptions; approved nicknames are retained.
